constants.stencil: cell (r,d) = Delta^(d+1) of pi(2^.) at r; entry 192's correction, gated against the six kernel values before any model number
constants.model: model_K = M + S_K; M = Delta^(d+1) R(2^.), R = Riemann's function via mpmath riemannr -- O34's measured convention (its TRUE_RES_R20 literals are R-stencil residuals to printed precision); the li-stencil is carried as a comparison at headline cells; S_K = partial sum of O90 PiModes c_k

constants.model_undefined_reason: model undefined: the Delta^(d+1) stencil reaches m = 0, x = 1, where Ei(rho*log 1) = -inf for every zero (and li(1) = -inf); the true cell is exact but no explicit-formula model value exists

taper.cesaro: S_K = sum_{k<=K} (1 - k/(K+1)) c_k, via prefix sums A_K - B_K/(K+1)
taper.gaussian: S_K = sum over ALL pairs of exp(-(gamma_k/G)^2) c_k; G(K) solves sum of weights = K (the weight sum is the effective pair count); K = N is the G -> inf limit, all weights 1, equal to the sharp K = N sum
taper.S_600_note: the S_600 field in cell records is the raw untapered full sum; under a taper the terminal model value is M + the tapered S at K = N

constants.prediction_under_test: entry 201: O34's sign-flip at (25,21) predicts K_cert blows up with depth, possibly beyond 600 at (20,6); a bounded small K_cert at (20,6) falsifies the 'arithmetic pins what spectrum cannot reach' inference

gaussian_mapping.definition: G(K) solves sum_{k=1..N} exp(-(gamma_k/G)^2) = K; float64 geometric bisection on the raw zero ordinates, dps-independent
